svg.aria-label: buildermesh across boxes, in five scenes: every box builds and its leads' events go through the NATS hub; a review job runs on whichever box is free; a lead's ask is pushed to your phone; a sleeping laptop's jobs wait on the hub; it wakes and catches up in order
svg.title: buildermesh across boxes

g.text: Every box runs leads through its own runner;
their progress events go through the NATS hub.
2. A review runs on whichever box is free.
app-012 queues a review job; it waits at the hub for a box that runs the kind.
hub-box's is busy, so build-box takes it; its reply goes back to app-012.
3. A lead asks; your phone hears.
app-012's ask goes through the hub to hub-box's daemon,
which pushes it to your phone with ntfy, once.
4. The laptop sleeps; work waits on the hub.
bmesh sync on hub-box sends it two level jobs;
they stay queued until it wakes (a job lives 24h).
5. It wakes and catches up, in order.
Its leaf reconnects, and it takes the jobs it missed in order:
one repo fast-forwards; a plugin's level waits for your approval.

svg.text: dials the hub; no NATS here

g.text: on wake: takes the jobs it missed
